visual.general_description: Color micrograph mosaic of four pink-purple stained tissue tiles with white triangle, star, arrow and rectangle markers.
visual.detailed_description: Landscape 2 by 2 mosaic of four pink-purple stained tissue sections on a yellow-green background, separated by dark-gray gutters, with no printed letters, numbers or scale bars. Top left: pink tissue with a lobulated pale-purple structure marked by a white triangle, a darker purple cell cluster, a thin pink surface layer at the right edge, and about three white star-shaped markers (two larger and one small at the left edge). Top right: scattered round pale vacuolated spaces in purple-pink tissue, two dark yellow-brown round structures each with a white arrow pointing right, and a thicker purple layered band at the right edge. Bottom left: a dark purple clump at the upper left with a large white upward arrow beneath it, sparse pale net-like tissue with two small white downward arrows, and pale lobules at the lower right. Bottom right: pink fibrous tissue with a folded purple-lined channel carrying a white rectangle marker.
